eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 5:20 PM on AUG 22, 2023 Effective until 5:20 PM AUG 23, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Out of an abundance of caution we are issuing a voluntary evacuation for the residents of the Town of Merryville, residents along Hwy 110W between Merryville and Singer and residence on Neale Field Rd East of Merryville. If you need transportation to evacuate there will be buses at Merryville Town Hall waiting to transport you to the DeRidder Junior High School.  Again this is a voluntary evacuation order at this time with the possibility of a mandatory order in the near future. Please do not panic and please drive carefully if you do leave your homes. Voluntary evacuation order. Please follow instructions in CAP alert
